items.question: Will I be charged automatically?
items.answer: No. Every plan is a one-time purchase for a fixed period. It simply stops when it expires — not a cent is deducted. Want to keep going? Just buy again.

items.question: How is MediaClaw different from other scraping extensions?
items.answer: Other scraping tools end at a data table; MediaClaw ends at your next viral post and your next customer. Basic scraping is free — what you pay for is the full workflow and the judgment layer: what topics to make, who to watch, who to contact.

items.question: What are credits? Do they expire?
items.answer: Credits are only used for in-extension AI tasks (transcripts, OCR, monitoring, analysis, rewriting). Scraping and sync never consume credits and are unlimited. Credits are usable while your membership is active; after expiry they are frozen (not cleared) and reactivate when you renew.

items.question: What if I run out of credits?
items.answer: Active members can top up anytime with a credit pack — see the Credit Packs tab above.

items.question: How long does the Free plan last?
items.answer: Free forever. Single-post scraping, basic lists, and watermark-free downloads have no time limit. Install it, use it, and upgrade only when it clicks.
